test_title: PYST 50: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Swastik saves 20% of his income while spends the remaining amount on food, rent, education and shoping. 15% of the income is spent on food, while Rs. 12,800 is spent on rent, ₹32,000 on education and ₹7,200 on shopping. The amount spent on shopping is 11.25% of the total expenditure. How much money (in Rs.) is spent on food?
solution:
**Given:**

Savings = 20%

15% of income is spent on food

Rent = ₹12,800

Education = ₹32,000

Shopping = 11.25% of total expenditure = ₹7,200

**Calculation:**

Let total income be 100x

⇒ Savings = 20x and Expenditure = 80x

According to the question,

11.25% of total expenditure = ₹7,200

⇒ (11.25/100) × 80x = 7200

⇒ (11.25/100) × (x) = 90

⇒ x = 90 × (100/11.25)

⇒ x = 800

Money spent on food = 15x

⇒ Money spent on food = 15 × 800

⇒ Money spent on food = 12,000

**∴ Swastik spends ₹12,000 on food.**
